routing_warnings.description: The empty prize-pool display is separate from the mint-number discrepancy retained under the target Requirement.
The personal dashboard count of 3 NFTs versus total supply of 2 primarily concerns dashboard inventory accuracy.
The Home Page Top Referrals value of 0 concerns the separate public referral-statistics Requirement.
The accepted decision to restart numbering and exclude old-contract NFTs is primarily a contract-migration state policy.
The report that some old data remained after the contract reset does not identify a specific mint statistic and is better reviewed under migration-state continuity.
